card.name: Words after check/evaluate/consider instructions
card.fires_on: The word right after a verb of checking or weighing, such as obtain history of, test for, evaluate for, consider whether or if, rule out. It marks the thing to be assessed, such as a history, an infection, or the benefit.

modes.label: The phrase about checking for a condition
modes.description: Word naming the condition or history to be looked for after test, evaluate, examine or rule out.
modes.example: Patients should be tested for HBV<< infection>> before initiating TNF blocker therapy

modes.label: The phrase about weighing the benefit
modes.description: The word benefit, or a link such as if, whether or the, after consider or assess, in a benefit-versus-risk instruction.
modes.example: Consider<< whether>> the benefits of estrogen therapy, including Ang

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that complete an assess-or-determine-whether phrase, while suppressing Chinese whether-type words.
card.plain: It responds to the word that follows an instruction to check, evaluate or weigh something, such as a history or the benefit.
